Marie (Marketing): Hey team — final run-of-show draft for next Wed. Quick read and confirmations please. Main asks: confirm mic-check slots, final slide deck link, and who will handle audience Q routing.

Marie (Marketing): TIMINGS (PDT):
- 18:00 green room open (ops + speakers)
- 18:15 mic checks (panelists A+B)
- 18:35 stage warmup (host + demo)
- 18:45 main session start (10m keynote, 25m demo/panel, 15m Q&A)
- 19:35 wrap + CTA

Diego (Marketing Ops): +1 — updated the public invite to reflect 18:45 start. mic checks: can we split into two 10m blocks? helps with timezone overlaps.

Emma (Producer): splitting is good. Proposed mic-check windows: 18:15-18:25 (panel A: Olivia + Sam), 18:25-18:35 (panel B: Alex + backup). StageBot: mic-check reminders scheduled to DM panelists at 18:10.

Sam (Speaker): good for me. I'll be on earlier for slides review at 18:00. can someone confirm the deck link?

Alex (AE): I can cover audience routing for commercial questions. I'll monitor the Q&A and flag leads to Diego via the private slack thread.

Olivia (Host): I'll do a 3-line intro and hand off to Marie for the demo. also can we add a short fallback line if demo API is slow? suggested: "If you see delays, try the lightweight mode in the docs."

Marie (Marketing): Good call. Adding fallback line to speaker notes. Deck link: https://drive.redwood/rd-webinar/2024-05-08-final-deck (version: v3). Everyone please upload final slides by EOD Tuesday.

Diego (Marketing Ops): Quick checklist items I still need:
- confirm camera + mic for each panelist (yes/no)
- designate on-call infra contact for live demo (preferably from eng-releases)
- set recording + transcription toggle in Zoom

Emma (Producer): On-call: pinging @eng-releases on this thread for who can standby. Also plan B: prerecorded clip of the demo (2m) in `assets/fallback/short-demo.mp4` if live demo fails.

Sam (Speaker): camera/mic: ✅ macbook + lav mic. slides final by tonight.

Alex (AE): camera/mic: ✅ external webcam, headset. available for Q flags.

Olivia (Host): camera/mic: ✅ test passed. I can run a quick 2-minute rehearsal of the handoff with Marie at 18:20.

Emma (Producer): Rehearsal plan:
```
18:00 join green room (all)
18:05 quick platform check (host+producer)
18:10 mic-check reminders go out
18:15 panel A mic-checks
18:25 panel B mic-checks
18:30 run rapid transitions (host->demo->panel)
18:40 final mute/unmute sweep
```

Marie (Marketing): Thanks — last two asks: 1) if you need captions, reply here and I'll enable them; 2) confirm availability window in case we need to push by 15m.

Diego (Marketing Ops): captions: yes please. availability window: can do until 20:30 PDT.

StageBot: Reminder scheduled: "Green room opens in 30m" -> 1736543706.

Marie (Marketing): Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker, call Emma first, then Diego. Otherwise see you in the green room — :thumbsup: 

Sam (Speaker): :thumbsup: see you all

Alex (AE): got it

Olivia (Host): cc @marie I'll run the fallback line if needed.
